newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore port to be corporatised by year end.
newsitem.headline: Singapore port to be corporatised by year end.

text.p: The Port of Singapore Authority (PSA) will be corporatised before the end of the year and privatisation would come later, Communications Minister Mah Bow Tan said on Monday.
"Corporatisation should, if all goes well, be in place before the end of this year," Mah told reporters.
"Only thing that is left now is for parliament to consider the new change and to approve it, so when parliament resumes we should be able to do that," he said.
Mah said privatisation would be "the next step, but we do not have a timetable for that, but obviously at the appropriate time".
Under the new corporatised structure, PSA would have two core groups -- the strategic business group and the strategic development group.
